guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Regarding Aptar’s outlook, Touya stated, “We expect Aptar to finish the year strong, supported by continued Pharma growth, particularly in consumer healthcare and injectables and without the headwind from emergency medicine destocking. Our Pharma pipeline remains strong, with new technologies and development programs expanding our reach across therapeutic areas and advancing opportunities for future growth. Closures continues its great momentum, with innovation helping drive increased demand, particularly for our beverage technologies. In Beauty, we remain focused on improving our long-term North American trajectory, while we continue to see pockets of healthy demand in areas, such as prestige fragrance, globally.”

Aptar currently expects adjusted earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be in the range of $1.39 to $1.47. This guidance assumes an effective tax rate range of 17.5% to 19.5%. The earnings per share guidance range is assuming a 1.12 Euro to USD exchange rate.
